entries.rationale: 기념 문장 sounds ad hoc as a headword; 기념 문구 is a transparent conventional label for commemorative wording.
entries.exampleKo: 역사적 사건을 다루는 기념 문구를 쓸 때는 사실과 현재의 해석을 구분해야 한다.
entries.exampleEn: When drafting commemorative wording about a historical event, facts should be distinguished from present-day interpretation.
entries.exampleDe: Bei einem Gedenktext zu einem historischen Ereignis sollten Fakten von heutigen Deutungen getrennt werden.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 재구성하다 is the standard verb for reshaping/reconstructing memory in historical or narrative analysis.
entries.exampleKo: 전시의 사진 배열이 바뀌면 관람객이 사건을 기억하는 방식도 새롭게 재구성될 수 있다.
entries.exampleEn: Changing the order of photographs in an exhibition can reshape how visitors reconstruct the event in memory.
entries.exampleDe: Eine veränderte Bildfolge in einer Ausstellung kann auch beeinflussen, wie Besucher das Ereignis in ihrer Erinnerung rekonstruieren.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 문지기 담론 is an overly literal calque of gatekeeping discourse; 배타적 팬 담론 states the social function directly.
entries.exampleKo: 누가 진짜 팬인지 끊임없이 가르는 배타적 팬 담론은 참여의 문턱을 높일 수 있다.
entries.exampleEn: Exclusionary fan discourse that constantly polices who counts as a real fan can raise barriers to participation.
entries.exampleDe: Ein ausschließender Fandiskurs, der ständig festlegt, wer als echter Fan gilt, kann die Teilhabe erschweren.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 보이지 않는 노동 is the established transparent term for unpaid/overlooked work; 보이지 않는 일 is too generic.
entries.exampleKo: 가족 행사를 준비할 때는 일정 조율과 연락처럼 보이지 않는 노동도 함께 나눠야 한다.
entries.exampleEn: When preparing a family event, invisible labor such as coordinating schedules and contacting people should also be shared.
entries.exampleDe: Bei der Vorbereitung eines Familienfests sollte auch unsichtbare Arbeit wie Terminabsprachen und Kontaktpflege geteilt werden.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 사위 사랑 is culturally interpretable but weak as a standalone lexical target. Teach the proverb/cultural framing in a note and use the productive verb phrase in exercises.
entries.exampleKo: 장모님이 사위를 잘 챙겨 주는 장면은 가족마다 다르게 받아들일 수 있다.
entries.exampleEn: A mother-in-law taking special care of her son-in-law can be interpreted differently from family to family.
entries.exampleDe: Dass eine Schwiegermutter ihren Schwiegersohn besonders umsorgt, kann je nach Familie unterschiedlich wahrgenommen werden.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 사진 전송 is UI/technical nominal style; adult everyday Korean more often uses the verb phrase 사진을 보내다.
entries.exampleKo: 단체 채팅방에 사진을 보내기 전에 같이 찍힌 사람에게 먼저 물어봤어요.
entries.exampleEn: Before sending the photo to the group chat, I asked the people in it first.
entries.exampleDe: Bevor ich das Foto in den Gruppenchat geschickt habe, habe ich die abgebildeten Personen zuerst gefragt.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 선물 분배 is unnecessarily administrative in ordinary family talk; 선물을 나누다 is more natural and productive.
entries.exampleKo: 양가에 가져갈 선물을 어떻게 나눌지 미리 정했어요.
entries.exampleEn: We decided in advance how to divide the gifts between the two families.
entries.exampleDe: Wir haben vorher festgelegt, wie wir die Geschenke auf beide Familien verteilen.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 선택적 보고 is the standard form for selective reporting.
entries.exampleKo: 유리한 결과만 보여 주는 선택적 보고를 피하려면 분석한 지표를 모두 공개해야 한다.
entries.exampleEn: To avoid selective reporting that shows only favorable results, all analyzed indicators should be disclosed.
entries.exampleDe: Um selektive Berichterstattung zu vermeiden, bei der nur günstige Ergebnisse gezeigt werden, sollten alle analysierten Kennzahlen offengelegt werden.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 손님으로 두다 is awkward; 손님처럼 대하다 is the natural way to describe continued outsider treatment.
entries.exampleKo: 가족이 된 뒤에도 계속 손님처럼 대하면 중요한 결정에서 의견을 내기 어려울 수 있다.
entries.exampleEn: If someone continues to be treated like a guest after joining the family, it can be difficult for them to have a say in important decisions.
entries.exampleDe: Wenn jemand auch nach der Aufnahme in die Familie weiter wie ein Gast behandelt wird, kann es schwer sein, bei wichtigen Entscheidungen mitzureden.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 시어머니 말씀 is not a useful lexical headword. The learnable skill is checking the intended meaning of an elder's remark.
entries.exampleKo: 시어머니 말씀의 뜻을 제가 제대로 이해했는지 배우자에게 먼저 확인했어요.
entries.exampleEn: I first checked with my partner whether I had understood my mother-in-law's remark correctly.
entries.exampleDe: Ich habe zuerst bei meinem Partner nachgefragt, ob ich die Worte meiner Schwiegermutter richtig verstanden hatte.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 역할 언어 is opaque and coined; 역할을 규정하는 표현 directly names the discourse function.
entries.exampleKo: '며느리니까 해야 한다'처럼 역할을 규정하는 표현은 개인의 선택을 의무처럼 보이게 만들 수 있다.
entries.exampleEn: Expressions that define someone by a role, such as 'you should do it because you're the daughter-in-law,' can make personal choices sound like obligations.
entries.exampleDe: Formulierungen, die eine Rolle festschreiben, können persönliche Entscheidungen wie Pflichten erscheinen lassen.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 일회용 밴드 is awkward as a learner headword; 반창고 is the standard everyday term.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 자동화된 결정 is the more transparent standard form in AI/accountability contexts.
entries.exampleKo: 자동화된 결정에 이의를 제기하려면 어떤 자료와 기준이 사용됐는지 확인할 수 있어야 한다.
entries.exampleEn: To challenge an automated decision, people need to be able to see what data and criteria were used.
entries.exampleDe: Um eine automatisierte Entscheidung anzufechten, muss nachvollziehbar sein, welche Daten und Kriterien verwendet wurden.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 자리를 재협상하다 is a literalized metaphor. 역할을 다시 조정하다 is natural and preserves the intended relational renegotiation.
entries.exampleKo: 가족 안에서 맡아 온 역할을 다시 조정하자 오래 미뤄 둔 갈등도 드러났다.
entries.exampleEn: When we readjusted the roles we had taken on in the family, long-postponed conflicts also surfaced.
entries.exampleDe: Als wir die bisherigen Rollen in der Familie neu ordneten, traten auch lange aufgeschobene Konflikte zutage.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 잘못된 안심 is understandable but awkwardly translated; 근거 없는 안도감 is more idiomatic in risk communication.
entries.exampleKo: 자료가 부족한데도 안전하다고 단정하면 사람들에게 근거 없는 안도감을 줄 수 있다.
entries.exampleEn: Declaring something safe despite insufficient data can give people a false sense of reassurance.
entries.exampleDe: Wenn man trotz unzureichender Daten Sicherheit behauptet, kann das ein unbegründetes Gefühl der Beruhigung vermitteln.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 장인어른 건강 is not a lexical unit; the useful Korean skill is politely asking about an elder's health.
entries.exampleEn: I first asked my father-in-law how his health was.
entries.exampleDe: Ich habe meinen Schwiegervater zuerst höflich gefragt, wie es ihm gesundheitlich geht.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 호칭 질문 is an unnatural nominalized headword; 호칭을 묻다 is productive and natural.
entries.exampleKo: 처음 만났을 때 어떻게 부르면 되는지 먼저 호칭을 물어봤어요.
entries.exampleEn: When we first met, I asked how I should address them.
entries.exampleDe: Beim ersten Treffen habe ich gefragt, wie ich die Person ansprechen soll.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.

entries.rationale: 호칭의 정치 reads like a coined essay title. 호칭과 권력 관계 states the analytical relation transparently.
entries.exampleKo: 이 논문은 가족 호칭이 친밀감뿐 아니라 권력 관계도 드러낼 수 있다고 분석한다.
entries.exampleEn: The paper analyzes how family forms of address can reveal not only intimacy but also power relations.
entries.exampleDe: Die Studie untersucht, wie familiäre Anredeformen nicht nur Nähe, sondern auch Machtverhältnisse sichtbar machen können.
entries.derivationPolicy: Retire the old derived cloze/sentence realization and regenerate textbook exercises from this canonical replacement concept.
